page_title: BET 3-0 RSO | Betis v Real Sociedad 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Jesus Manzano has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
90+1' The game is interrupted as Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is flagged offside.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Half-chance! Aitor Ruibal (Betis) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Remiro reacts well to snuff out the attack.

87' A cross by Marc Roca (Betis) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
85' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitor Roque (Betis) comes onto the pitch for Isco.
81' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Isco (Betis) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
79' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
77' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) replaces Luka Sucic.
75' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad). He’s got to go!

75' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad), but referee Jesus Manzano must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
75' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aitor Ruibal (Betis) replacing Angel Ortiz.
74' Angel Ortiz (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' Here is a change. Jesus Rodriguez is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Chimy Avila (Betis).
73' Substitution. Cucho Hernandez is replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
73' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
69' 3 - 0 Marc Roca (Betis) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
69' Angel Ortiz (Betis) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
69' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Antony (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
67' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick to Betis.
66' The attendance is 48758.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Marc Roca (Betis) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
61' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
59' That's the end of the game for Mikel Oyarzabal, who is replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
59' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Jon Aramburu and he is replaced by Jon Martin (Real Sociedad).
59' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
58' Wasted effort! Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
57' Antony (Betis) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
56' Marc Bartra (Betis) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
56' Marc Roca (Betis) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
56' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
54' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).
51' 1 - 0 Goal! Antony (Betis) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
50' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Antony (Betis) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
48' Antony (Betis) commits a foul and Jesus Manzano immediately signals a free kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Aihen Munoz is replaced by Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Marc Roca (Betis) and Giovani Lo Celso is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+3' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+3' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Alex Remiro easily deals with the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
44' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a throw-in.
41' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
41' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' Alex Remiro is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Antony (Betis). Easy save!
39' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
38' Antony (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
36' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the left post.
34' The linesman makes the right call and Betis will have a corner.
33' Alex Remiro anticipates the direction of the penalty by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis). He attempted to put the ball inside the right post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
32' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
32' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

32' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece. Betis are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
30' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
28' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
25' The substitution has been made. Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) has replaced Brais Mendez.
25' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
23' Isco (Betis) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
22' The game is interrupted now, Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
18' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
15' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
12' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Antony (Betis) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
8' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) heads on.
7' Isco (Betis) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
6' This is a yellow card! Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
4' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

4' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
3' It's a throw-in for Betis.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jesus Manzano.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
